features.name: v1_zscore
features.description: Standardized V1 using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance computation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes feature contribution to Euclidean distance in KNN neighborhoods.

features.name: v2_zscore
features.description: Standardized V2 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents V2 from being dominated or dominating in distance calculations.

features.name: v3_zscore
features.description: Standardized V3 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhood geometry by normalizing V3 scale.

features.name: v4_zscore
features.description: Standardized V4 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhood geometry by normalizing V4 scale.

features.name: v5_zscore
features.description: Standardized V5 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhood geometry by normalizing V5 scale.

features.name: distance_from_global_mean
features.description: Euclidean distance from the unsupervised global centroid in standardized space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a generic prototype distance indicating how typical/atypical a row is.

features.name: manhattan_from_global_mean
features.description: L1 distance from the unsupervised global centroid in standardized space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Complementary metric to Euclidean for robust neighborhood characterization.

features.name: chebyshev_from_global_mean
features.description: Maximum absolute standardized deviation across features (L-infinity distance).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether any single dimension is extreme, aiding outlier-aware neighborhood weighting.

features.name: low_freq_energy_ratio
features.description: Ratio of low-frequency coefficient magnitudes (V1+V2) to total magnitude across all coefficients; spectral shape descriptor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures spectral tilt which separates phoneme classes in cepstral feature space.

features.name: spectral_slope
features.description: Difference between lower and higher coefficient averages, approximating spectral slope.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a directional spectral feature that improves neighborhood discrimination.

features.name: high_magnitude_indicator
features.description: Indicator that the row lies far from the global centroid in standardized space (cluster boundary flag).
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN distinguish dense central regions from sparse boundary regions.

features.name: phoneme_spectral_regime
features.description: Semantic assessment of spectral regime: 0 if energy concentrated in low coefficients (V1,V2 dominant), 1 if balanced/mid-range, 2 if high-coefficient dominant (V4,V5 magnitudes exceed V1,V2). Reflects vowel-vs-consonant-like spectral character without using outcomes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a coarse categorical neighborhood indicator that improves local KNN voting in distinct spectral regions.
